scientific.integrity: The exact FedSplit proximal and centering updates are specialized directly to two scalar strongly convex quadratics. The client-state error matrix is derived symbolically, and finite termination follows from an exact nilpotency identity rather than numerical evidence.
limitations: Exactly two equally weighted scalar quadratic clients.
Exact proximal computation and a common scalar proximal parameter.
No finite-termination claim for more clients, nonquadratic objectives, or multidimensional noncommuting Hessians.
Curvature matching is an instancewise benchmark rather than a robust parameter-selection rule under unknown curvature.

title: Curvature matching makes two-client FedSplit terminate in two rounds
